reply_text:
I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in that channel on Oct 14. It's the only figure I found there, and I haven't checked it against the contract.

I couldn't search the knowledge brain (gbrain). It refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it can't tell whose access to apply. To fix it, someone on the brain host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`, or set the shared bot up to act on behalf of named members. Until then, I answered only from #central-team, which Hollis is a member of.
